values.note: 69 tent sites, 29 full-hookup RV sites and 39 water/electric trailer sites, plus lean-tos and a group site. Some larger tent sites are now sold as no-hookup 'Primitive Camper & Van' sites. Five full-hookup sites are held for month-long stays.

sites.source: https://www.burlingtonvt.gov/964/North-Beach-Campground ('There are 137 great sites'; '69 tent sites / 29 full hookup RV sites / 39 water and electric hookup trailer sites'; 'Five full-hookup sites have been set aside for month-long stays') + Firefly property page ('we have turned some of our bigger tent sites into Primitive Van and camper sites'), read 2026-11-16

values.note: $54 water and electric, $60 full hookup (tent $45, lean-to $50, group $100); an extra tent $5 a night; late checkout to 6 p.m. $15. Cancelling more than a week out costs $10 plus transaction fees.

fees.source: https://www.burlingtonvt.gov/964/North-Beach-Campground ('Rates for May 15 through October 15: Full Hook-up Site: $60 / Water and Electric: $54 / Tent Sites: $45 / Lean-to: $50 / Group sites: $100'), read 2026-11-16

values.note: Online only, through Firefly; the season's dates open in blocks between December and March (2027 bookings open January 6, 2027, 10 a.m.). Month-long full-hookup sites are booked through the campground office.

booking.source: https://www.burlingtonvt.gov/964/North-Beach-Campground ('All campground reservations must be made online.'; 2026 opening dates Dec 1 2025 - Mar 4 2026) + Firefly page ('2027 Campground Reservations will open January 6, 2027 at 10am est online only.'), read 2026-11-16

season.source: https://www.burlingtonvt.gov/964/North-Beach-Campground ('The campground is open May 15 through October 15.'), read 2026-11-16

facilities.source: https://www.burlingtonvt.gov/964/North-Beach-Campground ('Bathroom and hot shower facilities'; 'Free Wi-Fi is made available by Burlington Telecom') + campground map ('Dump Station & Trash Bins'), read 2026-11-16

note: City-run campground in Burlington's New North End, beside North Beach on Lake Champlain and the Burlington Greenway bike path; the sites are wooded, back from the beach. Enter from North Avenue: the campground map marks a 9-ft clearance on the beach-side road. --Claude
summary: City page + map + Firefly: 137 sites (29 FHU, 39 W/E, 69 tent), $54-60, online-only Firefly (platform operator, 2027 opens Jan 6), May 15-Oct 15, showers, dump, wifi; 5 FHU month-long sites only (not a seasonal park). Electric amperage unsourced (stored 50 derived). Not waterfront kept; pin sits on the public beach ~230 m from the campground loops. Phone/website unchanged.
flags: HOOKUPS: stored electric 50 / water / sewer are derived from old note prose ('30/50-amp'). The city page confirms full-hookup and water/electric sites but no amperage; Firefly's filter list is generic. Not rewritten; amperage unverified.

PIN: stored 44.4918,-73.2388 is on the sand of the public North Beach (day-use), west of the Greenway. The campground loops lie east of the Greenway, centre ~44.4935,-73.2372 (~230 m). Under 250 m but on the wrong side of the beach/bike path - move suggested.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): on imagery the nearest sites (tent sites 27-35 on the map, along the Greenway) are ~100-150 m from the water with the bike path, beach and day-use area between; the RV pads (1-16, 112-119, the W/E loops) are farther inland under trees. Lake Champlain is inland, so `coastal walk` does not apply.

ACCESS: campground map marks '9ft Clearance' on the road from the camping loops toward the beach/causeway; the entrance and office are on North Avenue, so it doesn't block access but a rig over 9 ft can't take that road. Noted in the proposed note.
LONG-STAY: 'For the first time ever we are offering longer-term campsites. Five full-hookup sites have been set aside for month-long stays' - 5 of 137, nightly otherwise. Not a seasonal park.
SITES: no max length published (Firefly asks the rig length at search). Stored max_rig_ft absent - left absent. Inclusion evidence accurate.
PHONE/WEBSITE: unchanged (802-862-0942 on the city page; both website lines live).
RULES worth knowing (not in fields): 14-day stay limit then 7 days away; 1 vehicle per site; minimum renter age 18.
